title: How payment works
patterns: how do i complete the payment
response: You click the buy button, the checkout page opens, you choose a payment method and confirm. Digital card payments are usually approved within seconds, and the access e-mail follows immediately.
followup: Want me to explain what the e-mail contains?

title: Card keeps getting declined
patterns: my card does not go through
response: Repeated declines almost always come from the card issuer, not the checkout. Call the number on the back of your card, authorize the online charge, then try again — or use a different card or wallet option at checkout.
followup: Would you like to try again with the link?

title: What happens right after paying
patterns: what do i get after paying
response: After approval you get an e-mail with your download links and access details, plus the setup tutorial. Download the files, extract them and copy the folder to your {{USB_SIZE}} USB drive.
followup: Should I walk you through the USB setup step by step?

title: Something went wrong while paying
patterns: something went wrong with the payment
i got an error while paying
response: First check whether the charge actually appears on your card — if the page froze after approval, the e-mail is usually on the way anyway. If the payment failed or you were charged without receiving the links, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} with the approximate time and amount and we will trace it.
followup: Do you want the checkout link to try once more?

title: Refunds and cancellations
response: Because this is a digital download delivered instantly, refunds follow the buyer policy shown on the checkout page. {{GUARANTEE}} If anything is wrong with the files or the download, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}} and we will fix it or take care of you.
followup: Anything you want to clarify before buying?

title: What shows on my statement
response: The charge appears on your statement in USD ({{PRICE}}) under the name of our checkout provider, which may differ from the product name. If you need a receipt or invoice for your records, email {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}.
